# site-motion-studies

> Rebuildable website motion effects for coding agents. Each effect folder
> contains a self-contained RECIPE.md (contract, mechanism, asset adaptation,
> acceptance checks) plus a minimal single-file demo. Read AGENTS.md for the
> consumption protocol.

## Studies

- [Oryzo](studies/oryzo/README.md): cinematic deadpan product launch for a
  cork coaster (https://oryzo.ai/)

## Effects: oryzo

- [Scroll scene state machine](studies/oryzo/effects/01-scroll-scene-state/RECIPE.md):
  global scroll → beat index → local progress; each beat owns one action
- [Object lift + shadow evidence](studies/oryzo/effects/02-object-lift/RECIPE.md):
  object rises while its anchored shadow shrinks, blurs and fades
- [Semantic color mode switch](studies/oryzo/effects/03-color-mode-switch/RECIPE.md):
  one attribute swaps the whole palette; color carries the meaning
- [Flip beat](studies/oryzo/effects/04-flip-beat/RECIPE.md):
  the object flips to show its underside; labels stay deadpan-still
- [Editorial rail + product stage](studies/oryzo/effects/05-rail-and-stage/RECIPE.md):
  fixed rail narrates; the object never moves a pixel
- [Measurement HUD labels](studies/oryzo/effects/06-measurement-hud/RECIPE.md):
  mono labels derived from live state; one accent on the active tick

## Patterns

- [Agent Reply Lifecycle](patterns/agent-reply-lifecycle/README.md): 一次 AI 回复的
  完整生命周期做成 35s 可拖动动效 —— 临界阻尼阶跃、一个高度做成四种滚动行为、
  几何决定可见度的运行时折叠、定高裁剪的推理缝隙、并行分叉/掉队/合流、
  CSS 挂载式流式出字、连续量驱动的常驻计划面板、静止中性 hover 才上色的引用上标。
  原创，不复刻任何具体产品。

## Meta

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how agents should consume and contribute
- [Study template](templates/study/): scaffold for new studies
- [index.html](index.html): 仓库首页（GitHub Pages），索引 + 内嵌演示
